```

}
```
From the earlier read (lines 596-656 output), the game block at relative lines 25-31:
```
// v5 玩法扩展常驻段：营建转化/天命积累/词条常驻/失地/整合

This block is NOT inside the matches! standard/world block — it appears after the legislator block at the same indent level. So qing scenario DOES flow through tick_standing already?
